matches.head: f87724057cc5fc5192fe2904675a563273612851

## Change and mathematical scope

Two masked Walsh source totals can leave the P112 coordinate column space, but this specific two-coordinate-reader family still cannot improve the copy-rank bill. A written support-cell reduction and exact finite premises give cost **at least 72 for every real coefficient matrix with two nonzero columns**, and **at least 77 when both masked sources are nonzero**, against the coordinate baseline 64. These continuous lower bounds are not asserted to be attained.
